info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Channel Specific By Param1-spec
info.description: The Channel Network Management API allows users to manage and update specific channel configurations based on provided parameters. This API facilitates the modification of branch network settings to enhance operational efficiency and align service delivery with business objectives. Typical consumers include banking applications and network administrators who require precise control over channel-specific operations. By utilizing this API, organizations can ensure their network channels are properly configured to meet customer needs and regulatory standards.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the specific network configurations for the branch identified by RES-100045. Ensure to provide the necessary fields for modification in the request body.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the properties of the branch network management resource identified by RES-100045. It requires a JSON object containing the fields that need to be modified, following the schema definitions specified.
